claim: You write the gloss, choose the hidden word, and save the passage with its source link.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create one note and assert its text and source URL

claim: The extension captures only selected text into its own local store.
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with the built extension; select one sentence, assert the capture dialog contains only that sentence, then save

claim: The demo loads three French, German, and Spanish sample notes, and demo changes never touch real notes.
where: landing action note, demo screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: seed a real namespace; reset and leave demo; assert the real note remains and demo storage is removed

claim: Reading notes stay on this device with no tracking requests.
where: landing facts and privacy section, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; intercept the full capture flow and assert every request is same-origin

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo context; wait for service worker, set context offline, reload, and assert three notes remain

claim: Exports and restores every reading note as JSON.
sandbox: fresh demo data; export all three notes, import one from that backup, and assert the restored count

claim: Space reveals an answer and keys 1–4 grade recall.
sandbox: fresh demo data; press Space then 3 and assert the answer is revealed and graded

claim: All tools are free to use without an account or subscription.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert capture, review, backup, and source tools have no sign-in, license gate, or billing request

claim: Filters show difficult notes or notes from one source.
where: landing free review tools section, review screen, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed easy and difficult notes from two sources, apply each filter, and assert only matching notes remain

claim: A JSON backup moves notes between the extension and web app in either direction.
where: extension popup, web notes toolbar, README
sandbox: fresh Chromium profile with the built extension; export an extension note into the web app, then export a web note and import it into the extension

claim: Delete any saved note from this device.
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed one local note, confirm deletion, and assert it is absent from the page and storage

claim: Downloads an installable Manifest V3 extension package.
sandbox: fresh production build and preview; request the public ZIP, assert a non-empty response, validate the archive, and inspect its MV3 manifest

claim: Source links accept only http: and https: addresses.
sandbox: fresh browser context; submit a javascript: source URL and assert an accessible error with no saved executable link
